title: Balaleet (Emirati sweet saffron vermicelli with omelette)
steps: Steep the saffron in 3 tablespoons of hot water for 10 minutes.
Melt the ghee in a wide pan and fry the vermicelli, stirring, until it turns golden brown.
Pour in the hot water, sugar, cardamom and saffron liquid and stir well.
Cover and cook on low heat for 8 to 10 minutes until the noodles are soft and the liquid has been absorbed, then stir in the rose water.
Beat the eggs with the salt and cook them in the oil as one thin, flat omelette.
Pile the vermicelli on a plate, lay the omelette over the top, and serve warm, tearing off pieces of omelette to scoop up the noodles.
